src/types/Formation.ts.description: Formation type definitions file created with PlayerPosition, Formation, FormationCategory, CreateFormationInput, StoredFormation, and FormationUpdate interfaces. Uses teamId ('team1'|'team2') and position tuple [number, number, number] to match PlayerModel.ts patterns.

src/components/UI/FormationSelector.tsx.description: Complete formation template flow verified: FormationSelector in Toolbar provides pre-built (7) and custom formations. Apply uses convertFormationToUpdates to map player IDs (`${teamId}-player-${playerNumber}`) and batch update via updateMultiplePlayers. Save captures current positions via convertPlayersToPositions and persists to IndexedDB. Delete with confirmation removes from IndexedDB. All flows validated via code review.

src/components/UI/Toolbar.tsx.description: FormationSelector integrated into Toolbar after Reset Players button. The component is self-contained with its own isOpen state, making integration simple - just add the component to the button group.

src/store/playerStore.ts.description: Global drag state tracking added via isDragging flag and setDragging() method. Used to prevent concurrent formation application during active player drag. canApplyFormation() checks both isUpdating and isDragging flags.
